::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 24 [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, C0171: Box 29
:::

Dear [Miss North](people/person_1090.qmd),
I hope the translation of '[Mulhause](other_books/otherbook_529.qmd)' is ready as this is the time at which it ought to be sent to the printers. I hope you were thanked for the [Hints on Reading](other_books/otherbook_530.qmd) but my time is much taken up at present by my [mother](people/person_1606.qmd)’s infirm state, and a friend who was staying here wrote for me. I think if possible it would be best to avoid French idioms in English 

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
